subject: Leap second
hook: LEAP SECOND IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Leap seconds are being eliminated entirely: after adding 27 seconds to civil time between 1972 and 2016, international authorities voted to abandon the disruptive practice and let atomic clocks drift up to a full hour away from solar time.
angle_support: In total, 27 leap seconds were added to UTC, with the final occurring on 31 December 2016; thus the difference between UTC and TAI has been, since January 2017, 37 seconds.

On 15 October 2026, the General Conference on Weights and Measures (CGPM) voted to discontinue the addition or subtraction of future leap seconds with effect from 20 May 2027, and to increase the limit on maximum permitted variance to one hour.
title: Why Timekeepers Voted to Kill the Leap Second
description: For decades, global standards inserted occasional corrections to synchronize atomic time with our planet's rotation. Software disruptions have prompted international authorities to abandon the system, allowing modern clocks to diverge from solar noon.
narration: LEAP SECOND IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture clocks eternally tied to the sun overhead. But pausing digital networks for Earth's wobbling spin caused too much chaos, so officials decided to abandon the fix. From 1972 through 2016, authorities injected twenty-seven extra ticks into civil time to track solar noon. Now, they have voted to stop entirely, allowing atomic readings to drift by up to a full hour. Human schedules are officially leaving the sun behind.
